checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
must.why: Large lit candle in a frosted jar centered in the frame.

must.item: The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
must.why: Jar edges are clean. The wooden lid floats slightly above the jar at an odd angle, and the rim is a bit soft.

must.item: The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
must.why: Only lavender and eucalyptus as props, on marble.

must.item: Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.
must.why: Soft window light, a neutral beige backdrop and white marble look like a retail product shot.

faults.what: The wooden lid hovers and tilts above the lit candle, which is physically odd. It is probably an AI artefact. Its position is implausible while the candle burns.

summary: A clean, attractive square product photo of a lit candle in a frosted jar on marble with lavender and eucalyptus, with no text; the only real flaw is the oddly floating lid and the low resolution.
